name: MEDIAC
recent: Media Chinese International 于2026年9月宣布以约RM19.88百万出售其位于加拿大温哥华的物业，此前已停止加拿大媒体业务。公司2026财年第一季度（截至6月30日）营收同比下滑4.5%，净亏损为390.4万美元，但亏损幅度较上一季度有所收窄。近期无其他重大企业活动。
notable: 间接全资子公司Ming Pao Holdings (Canada) Limited与Da Xing Investment Ltd签订买卖协议，以CAD6,850,000（约RM19,877,000）出售位于加拿大温哥华的物业。
risks: 公司2026财年第一季度净亏损390.4万美元，营收同比下滑4.5%。
earnings: 2026财年第一季度（截至6月30日）营收为3966.3万美元，同比下降4.5%，环比增长18.8%；净亏损390.4万美元，净亏损率为9.8%，较上一季度的26.3%有所收窄。

recent_en: Media Chinese International announced in September 2026 the disposal of its Vancouver property for approximately RM19.88 million, following the cessation of its Canadian media operations. For 1Q FY2026 (ended 30 June), revenue fell 4.5% year-on-year and net loss was US$3.904 million, though the loss narrowed from the previous quarter. No other major corporate activities were noted recently.
notable_en: Indirect wholly-owned subsidiary Ming Pao Holdings (Canada) Limited entered into a sale and purchase agreement with Da Xing Investment Ltd to dispose of a property in Vancouver, Canada, for CAD6,850,000 (approximately RM19,877,000).
risks_en: The company recorded a net loss of US$3.904 million in 1Q FY2026, with revenue down 4.5% year-on-year.
earnings_en: For 1Q FY2026 (ended 30 June), revenue was US$39.663 million, down 4.5% year-on-year but up 18.8% quarter-on-quarter; net loss was US$3.904 million with a net margin of -9.8%, narrowing from -26.3% in the previous quarter.
